sections.title: Bus route subscription prices per semester 2026/2027
sections.text: Nile University transportation fees 2026/2027 per semester. Sheikh Zayed: 8,800 EGP. October: 8,800 EGP. Hadayek Al Ahram: 9,800 EGP. Hadayek October: 9,800 EGP. Imbaba and Zamalek: 11,750 EGP. Abbasia and Ghamra: 11,750 EGP. Maadi: 13,250 EGP. Gesr El Suez and Ring Road: 13,250 EGP. Heliopolis (Masr El Gedida): 15,300 EGP. Nasr City: 15,300 EGP. Helwan: 15,300 EGP. Rehab and Tagamoa: 16,300 EGP. The displayed amounts are for one semester.

sections.title: Bus booking dates, subscribed bus rule and refund policy 2026/2027
sections.text: NU transportation subscription policy 2026/2027. Booking is open from 16 August 2026 through 24 September 2026, or until capacity is reached, whichever happens first. A student may not use a bus other than the bus to which the student subscribed. A refund requested during the first week from the start of study has a 10% deduction. A refund within the first month from the start of study has a 30% deduction. No subscription amount is refunded after the first month from the start of study.

sections.title: Minimum subscribers and route cancellation refund 2026/2027
sections.text: NU transportation subscription policy 2026/2027. A bus route requires a minimum of six subscribers. If the minimum number is not reached, the route is cancelled and the full subscription amount is refunded. This university cancellation with a full refund is distinct from a student's voluntary withdrawal deduction. The image does not expose live seat inventory, so current remaining seats must be confirmed through the transportation service.

sections.title: Undergraduate partial scholarships and combination cap
sections.text: UG Partial Scholarships: Early Admission 10% (1st year only). Schools MoU 10% (1st year only). Events (Edu Gate) 10% (1st year only). Sports 5% renewed every year. Government Employees' Sons and Daughters 10% renewed every year. Siblings 10% renewed every year: the second, third and subsequent siblings get this scholarship as long as the first sibling is enrolled at NU. Partial Merit Scholarship 50%, 40% or 20% depends on the score of high school. MoU Sponsored Partial Scholarships: for a specified duration with GPA constraints. Entry students can combine up to 3 UG partial scholarships (including Merit Scholarships) with a cap of 60%.
